# The options of curl that take a value: those of the *.md files of
# https://github.com/curl/curl/tree/dc99e1274b2bb368dea509ac6694d34e93c50054/docs/cmdline-opts
# (not _*.md) with an Arg: line, by their Long: and Short: lines, one
# spelling a line. curl/curl dc99e1274b2bb368dea509ac6694d34e93c50054,
# retrieved 2026-10-19. To make it again:
#   S=dc99e1274b2bb368dea509ac6694d34e93c50054
#   gh api "repos/curl/curl/git/trees/$S?recursive=1" --jq '.tree[].path | select(startswith("docs/cmdline-opts/") and endswith(".md")) | select(test("/_")|not)' |
#   while read -r p; do f=$(curl -sfL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/curl/curl/$S/$p"); echo "$f" | grep -q '^Arg:' || continue
#     echo "$f" | sed -n 's/^Long: */--/p;s/^Short: */-/p'; done | sort -u
